title: Pure Regenesis
summary: Pure Regenesis control deck consisting solely of archetype members and generic Rank 7 and 8 Xyz Monsters, omitting outside engines like Kashtira, Dogmatika, and Bystial. Every monster in the lineup shares 2500 ATK and 2500 DEF, creating a recursive loop of free Special Summons, spot removal, and Spell negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Regenesis Archfiend reveals another 2500 ATK and DEF monster in your hand to Special Summon itself and searches any Regenesis card from your Deck.
Regenesis Lord banishes a 2500 ATK and DEF monster from your hand or face-up field to Special Summon itself, then Sets a Regenesis Spell or Trap directly from your Deck.

Regenesis searches or mills any Regenesis monster from your Deck on activation, and while you control a 2500 stat monster, it can search or mill any 2500 ATK and DEF monster or revive one from the GY.
Regenesis Code is a Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons a Regenesis monster directly from your Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon a banished 2500 stat monster.

summary.title: Opening: Regenesis Archfiend + Any 2500 Monster
steps: Reveal a 2500 ATK and DEF monster in hand to Special Summon Regenesis Archfiend.
Trigger Regenesis Archfiend to search Regenesis Lord from your Deck.
Special Summon Regenesis Lord by banishing the revealed 2500 monster, and use Lord's effect to Set Regenesis Birth directly from the Deck.
Special Summon Regenesis Sage from your hand alongside your 2500 monsters to establish Quick Effect negation.
Set Regenesis Birth to disrupt the opponent on their turn by flipping a monster face-down or swarming your banished and GY Regenesis monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Regenesis Sage summons itself while you control a 2500 ATK and DEF monster, and sends a Regenesis card from hand or face-up field to the GY to negate an opponent's card or effect.
Regenesis Warrior tributes itself on either turn as a Quick Effect to bounce an opponent's monster to the hand.
Regenesis Dragon tributes itself on either turn as a Quick Effect to banish a Spell or Trap card your opponent controls.

Regenesis Overlord Special Summons itself from the GY by banishing two 2500 ATK and DEF monsters from your hand, field, or GY, and returns cards from the field to the hand up to the number of your banished 2500 stat monsters.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Regenesis Birth flips an opponent's monster face-down, and during the opponent's turn, it can Special Summon any number of your banished or GY Regenesis monsters with different names.
Regenesis Code provides instant on-demand monster access from the Deck during either player's turn, dodging removal or triggering summon effects.
Regenesis recycles discarded or tributed monsters from the GY back to the field once per turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Regenesis Cycle and Regenesis Commands are not yet released in the TCG, and outside engines like Kashtira and Bystials are omitted to preserve pure archetype synergy.
